name: The Empress of Aeser
source:
“THE EMPRESS' SHADOW IS DETERMINED TO RESURRECT THE DEAD EMPIRE...”

“WILL YOU STOP HER?”

You play as Tetrine Reish in this narrative adventure game. You were born with the rare ability to see magic, which got you killed last winter (during the events of [url=https://vndb.org/v14816]Asher[/url]). You got better. Sort of.

You find yourself alive again (sort of) and working for a woman named Kalevel to find a way to lift her sister's curse. Only, her sister is the Empress' Shadow and the Shadow wants you dead.

Still, you're not going to hold a thing like that against her. She can't help what she was made to be. The Shadow's curse twisted her into an automaton in service of the previous empress, after all, but it's not her fault she wants to restore an old dark empire.

If you can find a magical cure, the Empress' Shadow doesn't have to die. Your employer will be happy and you will be happy because the Shadow will stop trying to kill you. It's a win-win all around.

How hard could it be?

[From [url=http://sunlabyrinth.com/teoa.php]official website[/url]]
translation:
“女皇之影决心复活死去的帝国……”

“你会阻止她吗？”

你在这款叙事冒险游戏中扮演Tetrine Reish。你生来就有一种罕见的看到魔法的能力，这让你在去年冬天被杀（在[url=https://vndb.org/v14816]Asher[/url]事件期间）。你好多了。有点像。

你发现自己又活了过来（某种程度上），并为一位名叫卡利夫的女人工作，寻找解除她姐姐诅咒的方法。只是，她的妹妹是女皇的影子，而影子想要你死。

不过，你不会因为这样的事情而反对她。她无法改变自己被造就的样子。毕竟，暗影的诅咒将她扭曲成一个为前任皇后服务的机器人，但她想要恢复一个古老的黑暗帝国并不是她的错。

如果你能找到神奇的治疗方法，女皇之影就不必死。你的雇主会很高兴，你也会很高兴，因为影子将不再试图杀死你。这是一个双赢的局面。

这有多难？

[来自[url=http://sunlabyrinth.com/teoa.php]官网[/url]]
